{{Quote|We forced the Empire off our world once. They fought with blasters and fighters, destroying cities at will. We fought with whatever we had&mdash;kitchen utensils, industrial tools, our bare hands. We won that time.|Gial Ackbar|<ref name="Dark Empire Sourcebook" />}}
'''Dac''', as it was called in [[Mon Calamari (language)/Legends|Mon Calamarian]], [[Quarrenese/Legends|Quarrenese]], and [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], also known as '''Mon Calamari''', and sometimes simply called '''Calamari''' or '''Mon Cala''', was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mon Calamari system/Legends|Calamari system]] of the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]], located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. It was home to a wealth of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]: the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]], the [[Moappa]], the [[Amphi-Hydrus]], and the [[Whaladon/Legends|Whaladons]]. ''Mon Calamari'' was the name given to the planet by [[Human/Legends|Human]] explorers from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who first discovered and revealed the world to the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The native species referred to the planet as ''Dac''. The planet was a shining bluish-white orb from [[Realspace/Legends|space]], due to its [[Calamari Sea|ocean]]-covered surface. It was home to 27.5 billion Mon Calamarians and Quarren, as well as surrounded by the impressive [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards]].

In [[137 ABY]], all life on the planet was wiped out in accordance with the [[Final Protocol]] ordered by [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok]] of the [[One Sith]] with the use of [[viral spore]]s to punish the Mon Calamari for rendering aid to the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant|remnants]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. Nearly 20% of the planet's population was saved during the [[Evacuation of Dac]].

==Description==
[[File:Mon_Cal_city_TFUCG.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A Mon Calamari city]]
An [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Mon Calamari system/Legends|Calamari system]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]], Dac was home to two [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]]. The planet's [[Standard year/Legends|years]] lasted 398 [[Standard day/Legends|days]], and each day lasted 21 [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]]. Apart from a few reefs and atolls, the entirety of the planet was covered in [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]]. Dac was located on the [[Overic Griplink/Legends|Overic Griplink]] and the [[Giblim Route]], two [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]].<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>

===Flora and fauna===
Numerous life-forms dwelled on Dac. In addition to the Quarren and Mon Calamari, the [[Whaladon/Legends|Whaladon]], [[Moappa]], and the [[Mollusk/Legends|mollusks]] of the [[Knowledge Bank]] possessed some form of intelligence.<ref name="Strongholds" /> Other species included the [[needlefish]], [[tumblebasker]], and [[seatree]].<ref name="GATORW" />

==History==
===Early millennia===
[[File:QuarrenNEGAS.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]]]]
Long before the Mon Calamari evolved, Dac was inhabited by the [[Moappa]], an aquatic species of glowing invertebrates.<ref name="Fierce Currents" />

The Mon Calamari lived comfortably on the surface and below while the Quarren lived in the depths of the oceans. The massive [[Whaladon/Legends|Whaladons]] meddled little in governmental affairs, swimming in their pods and protected from hunting by law.

Despite their enmity for one another, the Quarren and Mon Calamari species united under [[Mon Calamari monarchy|one government]] in [[4500 BBY]]. This government was a [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchy]], and its first [[King/Legends|King]] was [[Morn (king)|Morn]].<ref name="Strongholds" />

The planet was discovered by outsiders in [[4166 BBY]]; by that time, its inhabitants had already been exploring nearby star systems for several years.<ref name="KOTORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> First contact with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] occurred on the world of [[Ruisto]], a planet colonized by the Mon Calamari. In the following millennium, over a dozen more worlds were settled by Mon Calamari and Quarren settlers from Mon Cala.<ref name="Strongholds" />

During the conflict with the [[Eternal Empire]], the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] were patrolled by schools of [[Pliffer Fish]] who were known to feed on toxins. Some individuals attempted to acquire breeding pairs in order to clean up industrial spills on other [[Planet/Legends|worlds]].<ref name="Fish" /> Not long before the [[New Sith Wars]]<ref name="Strongholds" /> which began in [[2000 BBY/Legends|2000 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Mon Cala became an ally world of the Republic. Although the Mon Calamari wanted the planet to become a full member of the Republic, the Quarren did not, and the Chieftan of the Quarren, [[Allat Za]], negotiated the compromise that gave Dac its new status. Despite this victory, the Quarren still came to feel more and more marginalized by the Mon Calamari.<ref name="Strongholds" />

Around five hundred years before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], a number of needy Mon Calamari and Quarren locals were approached by recruiters sent by [[Hugo Bartyn]]. Bartyn wanted amphibian fishermen to settle a new city in [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]] and tempted these poverty-stricken individuals with promises of untouched seas in a new frontier. Once they arrived, however, they became [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] laborers.<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref>

===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|Troubled is the planet Mon Calamari. Its races have divided. The droid army of the Quarren Isolation League moves against the Calamari Council. Alone, the Calamari are no match. Intervene we must!|Yoda|<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 5" />}}
The planet was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by the corrupt [[Tikkes/Legends|Tikkes]], who allowed [[Thalassian slavers/Legends|Thalassian slavers]] to operate in the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]] for a share of their profits. He was exposed in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. He escaped [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] custody on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and fled to [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], where he became a member of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] as leader of the [[Quarren Isolation League]], which sought to cut ties between Mon Calamari and the Republic.
<div style="float:right">[[File:Calamari_council.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[Mon Calamari Council]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]]]</div>
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the world was attacked multiple times by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. First, [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] [[Attack on Mon Calamari (Clone Wars)|devastated]] the world with the [[Force Harvester]].<ref name="TCW video game">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]]</ref> Later, Tikkes's [[Quarren Isolation League/Legends|Quarren Isolation League]] attempted to overthrow the [[Mon Calamari Council]]. Tikkes's actions led to a [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Clone Wars)/Legends|conflict]] between the two native peoples, but the League was defeated by [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and the [[Mon Calamari Knights/Legends|Mon Calamari Knights]].<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 5" /> It was discovered by Kit Fisto that the League was allied with the Moappa, whom Kit discovered were also sentient. Kit informed the Mon Calamari that they needed to make peace with and respect the sapience of the Moappa.<ref name="Fierce Currents" />

Many members of the Quarren Isolation League and the Free Dac movement fled Mon Calamari, settling on the CIS worlds of [[Pammant/Legends|Pammant]] and [[Minntooine/Legends|Minntooine]], where the [[Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps/Legends|Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps]] created [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]]. Using designs based on [[Mon Calamari Shipyards/Legends|Mon Calamari Shipyards]] blueprints stolen by the CIS as a basis, these yards created [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyers]] at Minntooine and [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyers]] at the [[Pammant Docks/Legends|Pammant Docks]] for the Separatist [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]].<ref name="ROTS ICS">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>

There were also Separatist Mon Calamari, led by the heroic Commander [[Merai]], backed by [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]] and the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]]. Without the approval of Count Dooku, the Mon Calamari led an effective assault during the [[First Battle of Kamino]], using their [[amphibious fighter]]s and Merai's personal assault ship, the [[Shark (starfighter)|''Shark'']]. Ultimately their assault failed, as Dooku betrayed them. Most of the Mon Calamari forces were able to escape the disaster due to the sacrifice of Merai.<ref name="Republic 50">[[Republic 50|''Republic'' 50]]</ref>

[[File:MonCalamari-GA.png|thumb|left|250px|A ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer approaches Dac during the [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|Battle of Mon Cala]]]]
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Water War Date">{{TCWdates|401}}</ref> tensions between the Mon Calamari and Quarren began to escalate again, with many Quarren especially being dissatisfied with the planet's Mon Calamari&ndash;controlled monarchist government and their close relationship to the Republic.<ref name="Water War" /> While [[Yos Kolina/Legends|Yos Kolina]], the eighty-second and current [[King of Mon Cala/Legends|King of Mon Cala]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> mediated the dispute, the Separatist leader [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] prepared an invasion of the [[Mon Calamari system/Legends|Calamari system]]. Dac held strategic importance to the Republic's war effort at this time, due to the planet providing Republic [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] with a special [[Ore/Legends|ore]] to strengthen [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plating.<ref name="CWA: Iceberg Three">{{TCWA|Mission on Iceberg Three}}</ref> As part of their invasion plans, the Separatists sent Commander [[Riff Tamson/Legends|Riff Tamson]] to assassinate Kolina and push the Mon Calamari and Quarren towards civil war.<ref name="Prisoners" /> In the wake of Kolina's death,<ref name="Water War" /> the Quarren began a dispute with the Mon Calamari regarding their sovereignty and the monarchy's line of succession.<ref name="Insider 129: Blood-Feud">{{InsiderCite|129|Blood-Feud: Warriors of the Deep!}}</ref> Hoping to break free from the rule of the Mon Calamari, the Quarren challenged the monarchy, wanting one of their own on the throne instead of the heir apparent [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Lee-Char/Legends|Lee Char]]. As the [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] crisis continued to unfold, [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]], [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Mon Calamari Guard/Legends|Mon Calamari Guard]], asked the Republic to send representatives to help mediate the situation.<ref name="Water War" /> Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] General Anakin Skywalker were sent to Dac,<ref name="CWA: Iceberg Three" /> but the Quarren [[Chief/Legends|Chieftan]], [[Nossor Ri/Legends|Nossor Ri]], responded by asking for an [[Envoy/Legends|envoy]] from the Separatists' side to be present for the negotiations as well, a call that was answered by Tamson. Exploiting the tensions between the Quarren and Mon Calamari, Tamson convinced Ri to side with the Separatists so that the Quarren could claim control over Dac.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Unbeknownst to the Quarren, however, Tamson had made a deal with Dooku to become Dac's ruler after the planet fell under Separatist control.<ref name="Prisoners" />

Following the failure of a peace conference, the Separatists, led by Tamson, and the Quarren, led by Ri, began a combined assault on Dac's capital, [[Coral City/Legends|Coral City]]. The Mon Calamari and their Republic reinforcements continually lost ground,<ref name="Water War" /> with all of them eventually being captured by Tamson and put to work in [[Prison/Legends|prison]] camps for Dooku and the Confederacy.<ref name="Gungan Attack">{{TCW|Gungan Attack}}</ref> Tamson then took Kolina's throne for himself, much to the shock of Ri and the Quarren, who began to regret their alliance with the Confederacy. When Lee-Char and his Jedi protector, [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], were the only ones who had evaded capture, Dooku sought to finish what he had begun with Kolina's assassination: the termination of the royal bloodline through the execution of the prince.<ref name="Prisoners" /> Despite the fear of living up to his [[Parent/Legends|father]],<ref name="Insider 129: Blood-Feud" /> Lee-Char took his place as leader of the Mon Calamari, using his father's old friendship with Ri to convince the Quarren to re-side with them and the Republic. This led to the defeat of Tamson and the removal of the Separatist presence on Dac, and Lee-Char succeeding his father as Dac's ruler.<ref name="Prisoners" />

After the Republic loyalty of the planet was cemented, the [[Loyalist/Legends|Loyalist]] inhabitants agreed to a new arrangement: dual representation in the Senate, with [[Tundra Dowmeia/Legends|Tundra Dowmeia]] representing the Quarren and [[Meena Tills/Legends|Meena Tills]] representing the Mon Calamari. Meena Tills was held hostage on Coruscant by [[Korun/Legends|Korunnai]] terrorists, but rescued by [[Clone commando/Legends|Republic Commandos]]. Both Senators were signatories of the [[Delegation of 2000]]'s petition, resulting in their arrest upon the [[Declaration of a New Order]].

===Imperial era===
The planet was represented in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] by [[Timi Rotramel]] until it was harshly subjugated by the Galactic Empire, which saw the people of Mon Calamari as natural slaves whose industries and resources could be used to power the Imperial war machine in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Empire31">[[Empire 31|''Empire'' 31]]</ref> and was angry about the role the Quarren had played in supporting the Separatist cause during the Clone Wars.<ref name="Strongholds" /> The attacking Imperial forces, commanded by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], were aided during the occupation by the sabotage of the planetary [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] by Quarren Isolationist League saboteurs such as [[Seggor Tels]] and swiftly conquered the planet, killing Lee-Char in the process.<ref name="Strongholds" />

During the Imperial occupation of the planet and its [[Star system/Legends|system]], the Mon Calamari started a [[Mon Calamari Resistance|resistance movement]], which was unsuccessful at first. Eventually, three of the planet's floating cities were destroyed in reprisal. Regardless, the Imperial attack did not succeed in breaking the Mon Calamari spirit. Instead of extinguishing the resistance, it pushed the world's natives into open rebellion when the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] joined the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] against the invaders in a grand and secret military effort which finally [[Calamarian Revolt|repelled]] the Imperials and pushed them off their planet, their system and indeed the entire [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="Strongholds" /> Shortly after the uprising, while preparing the planet to join efforts with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the [[Senator/Legends|Imperial Senator]] Timi Rotramel attempted to bring other species and systems into the Rebellion against the Empire; unfortunately for Rotramel, shortly after failing to convince the [[Tiss'shar/Legends|Tiss'shar]] to join a Sector rebellion, he was killed on Tiss'shar by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], who discovered his secret rendezvous with Tiss'shar President [[Si-Di-Ri]].
[[File:MonCalamariBombingRun.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Imperial TIE bombers attacking a floating city on Dac]]

The Imperial propaganda did not wait to attempt to discredit the Mon Calamari, as the Imperial [[sentientologist]] [[Obo Rin]], working under the direction of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Vader, wrote the ''[[Catalog of Intelligent Life in the Galaxy]]''. This work included falsified claims that the first contact between the Mon Calamari and galactic civilization occurred during the reign of the Galactic Empire. This was accepted as truth by many citizens of the Empire, further angering the Mon Calamari.

After Mon Calamari's revolution against the Empire, the Mon Calamari and the Quarren joined with the Rebel Alliance, proving to be an invaluable asset in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Mon Calamari, masters of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] construction, supplied the Alliance with badly needed [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] constructed at the [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards]]. Prior to joining the Alliance, the Mon Calamari had only built passenger liners and deep-space exploration vessels because of their peaceful ethos, but by heavily retrofitting these vessels, they were able to create [[Warship/Legends|warships]] that could take on the Empire's mighty ships of the line.

The Mon Calamari disrupted and mined known routes that led to their sector, while searching for new secret routes. In order to retake Dac the Empire would have to launch a long campaign that might embolden other rebel planets. Therefore the Imperial attack was postponed.<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

[[File:Mon_Calamari_TEA.jpg|thumb|200px|Mon Calamari with visible islands]]
During this time of war, the Mon Calamari and Quarren of Dac lived under the constant threat of an attack by Imperial fleets. The Alliance maintained a strong presence in the star system, including enough capital ships to defend against a standard Imperial battle line or perhaps even a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], but the Alliance and the Mon Calamari didn't have enough firepower in the system to repel a full Imperial attack squadron. The main Alliance fleet was considered too precious to risk in such a dangerously exposed position.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> As early as [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] [[Bureau of Operations/Legends|Imperial Intelligence Operations]] sent operatives to the planet in preparation for Imperial strikes on the planet's floating cities.<ref name="SWGItdm">{{GalaxiesAED}} - Imperial terminal delivery mission "Mon Calamari Attack Orders"</ref>

While the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] was fighting over [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], massive Imperial fleets moved to besiege Mon Calamari Space. The [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star]] would destroy Dac once completed, but Emperor Palpatine died before the Empire could put its plans into action. Imperial commanders turned into independent warlords after the Battle of Endor and fortunately Moff [[Ardus Kaine|Kaine]] withdrew to another side of the galaxy instead of attacking Dac.<ref name="EGTW" />

By the time of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruisers]] were extensively used by the Alliance, playing a major role in the hands of Mon Calamari [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] Gial Ackbar, who put them to good use in that decisive battle.

===Anchor of the New Republic===
[[File:Moncalcity.jpg|thumb|right|240px|A Mon Calamari city]]
Mon Calamari was a founding member of both the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Ackbar represented the planet on the [[New Republic Provisional Council]]. The New Republic defeated further Imperial invasions thrice at Mon Calamari: the first time against the Whaladon hunting submarines of Emperor [[Trioculus]]'s [[Trioculus' Empire|Imperial faction]];<ref name="TGoDV" /> the second against the [[World Devastator]]s of the resurrected [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Dark Empire]];<ref name="Dark Empire 3">[[Dark Empire 3|''Dark Empire'' 3]]</ref> and the third against the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] of Admiral [[Natasi Daala|Daala's]] [[Maw fleet]].<ref name="Dark Apprentice" /> These three battles caused many cities to be destroyed, and members of all the indigenous sentient species suffered loss of life. During the battle against Daala, Leia Organa Solo discovered that the Mon Calamari Ambassador [[Cilghal]], Ackbar's niece, was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]. Cilghal was the first Mon Calamari to join the [[New Jedi Order]].<ref name="Dark Apprentice" /> The planet was later represented in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] by [[Q-Varx]], who was revealed as a traitor and replaced by Cilghal.<ref name="PoT">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref>

===Birth of the Galactic Alliance===
During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the planet was represented by both the Quarren [[Pwoe]] and the Mon Calamari [[Gron Marrab]]. After the fall of Coruscant to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], the remaining senators and politicians of the new Republic government fled to Mon Calamari, which had not been taken by the Yuuzhan Vong. The world's massive shipyards, large defensive fleet, and isolation from the front lines made it a desirable location. Pwoe tried and failed to usurp the New Republic presidency and eventually joined the [[Ylesian Republic]] on [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]]. Marrab, however, remained loyal, and represented his homeworld in the Senate. Following the election of [[Cal Omas]] as the new Chief of State, the New Republic was reorganized into the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]], or Galactic Alliance in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]]. The Alliance was formed on Mon Calamari, which served as its original capital until the end of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

===Second Imperial Civil War===
{{Quote|In your&hellip; absence, Lord Krayt, the traitor Wyyrlok's ill-advised campaign of terror has backfired. Resistance stiffened in the wake of the poisoning of the planet Dac.|High Moff Morlish Veed, to Darth Krayt|<ref name="LW2">[[Legacy — War 2|''Legacy — War'' 2]]</ref>}}
[[File:Battle_Mon_Calamari_137_ABY.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The planet Dac and its shipyards during the Second Imperial Civil War]]
After the [[Sith–Imperial War]], the planet was once again under [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] control.<ref name="Leg21">[[Legacy (2006) 20|''Legacy'' (2006) 20]]</ref> Under the rule of usurper Emperor and [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]], the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] were placed in charge of the planet, as the [[One Sith|new Sith Order]] held a number of Quarren amongst its members, most notably [[Darth Azard]] and the late [[Darth Maleval]].
In an attempt to destroy [[Gar Stazi]] and the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]], who the Calamari supported in secret, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Dru Valan]] laid a trap at Mon Calamari by leaking information about the [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Imperious'']], a [[Imperious-class Star Destroyer|new type]] of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] that was under construction at the [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards]]. The resulting [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Second Imperial Civil War)|battle]] resulted in the destruction of more than half of the Shipyards.<ref name="Leg21" />

[[File:BattleOfDevilsCrevasse-Legacy33.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Mon Calamari was attacked during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]].]]
Krayt was angered by the theft of the ''Imperious'', and decided to take his anger out on the Mon Calamari people. He traveled to Dac, and during an address to the [[Mon Calamari Council]], he ordered the [[Genocide on Dac|immediate execution]] of one-tenth of their population. After [[Massacre of New Coral City|initiating the massacre]] by having the members of the Council itself killed, Krayt commanded that the remainder of the Mon Calamari population be rounded up and incarcerated in work camps; those Mon Calamari who tried to escape this fate were to be pursued and killed. Krayt's ultimate goal in this matter was to render the Mon Calamari extinct and to "purge the galaxy of their culture and history" as a warning to anyone else who had notions of defying [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|his empire]].<ref name="Legacy 22" /><ref name="Legacy 24">[[Legacy (2006) 24|''Legacy'' (2006) 24]]</ref>

Following the initial death of Darth Krayt, Krayt's [[Regent/Legends|regent]], [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok]], fully took control of the One Sith. No longer desiring to waste Imperial resources on the planet or in long and costly campaigns, Wyyrlok issued an [[Final Protocol|edict]] calling for the immediate termination of the genocide. The ocean's water was then [[Viral spore|poisoned]] by Sith scientist [[Vul Isen]] in an attempt to wipe out all life on the planet. However, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] Gar Stazi refused to abandon the native [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and other innocent inhabitants without an [[Evacuation of Dac|evacuation attempt]].<ref name="Leg47">[[Legacy (2006) 47|''Legacy'' (2006) 47]]</ref>

[[File:Covering_the_evac_of_Dac.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Alliance'']] covering evac ships fleeing Dac]]
Stazi led the [[Core Fleet|Galactic Alliance Core Fleet]] to Dac, reinforced by an elite [[Sword Squadron (Jedi)|squadron]] of Jedi to the dying planet. A task force under [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Drok]] succeeded in sabotaging the defenses of the Mon Calamari Shipyards, and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Asaak Dan]] led a group of [[Mon Calamari Rangers]] in securing [[Heurkea Floating City]] to serve as the base of operations for the evacuation. Capturing additional ships in the Shipyards, the Alliance easily overwhelmed remaining Sith forces. With the planet under control, a massive fleet of private ships from all across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] exited [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], and began the rescue operation.<ref name="Leg47" />

[[File:FinalProtocol.jpg|thumb|left|225px|Dead floating in the water following the Final Protocol]]
With the Galactic Alliance fleet engaged in rescue operation, the Sith sprung their trap. The [[Outer Rim Third Fleet]], under the command of Admiral [[Krion Grail]] and supervised by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Geist (Moff)|Geist]] and [[Fist]] [[Darth Stryfe]], emerged from hyperspace behind the Alliance fleet.<ref name="Leg47" /> Focusing on protecting the evacuation fleet, the Alliance fleet suffered heavy damage. As all seemed lost, however, a number of Star Destroyers belonging to [[Roan Fel]]'s [[Empire-in-exile]] appeared, surrounding the Imperial fleet. Now trapped themselves, Stryfe and Geist ordered a retreat, leaving Dac safe for evacuation.<ref name="Leg47" />

Unfortunately, it was already too late for most of the planet's population. The combined Alliance, Imperial, and civilian fleet was only able to save around twenty percent of Dac's Mon Calamari, Quarren, Whaladons, and Moappa. While numbering in the billions, it was only a small percentage of the world's total population of 27 billion, and did not include the even greater amount of creatures and other unique life forever lost beneath the waves.<ref name="Leg47" />

===Galactic Triumvirate===
[[File:Dac_shipyard_remnants.png|thumb|right|250px|Remnants of the Mon Calamari Shipyards]]
Following the defeat of the [[One Sith]], the Sith were driven underground again, and a [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]], consisting of the Fel Empire, the Jedi Order, and the Galactic Alliance, assumed power in Coruscant. In [[138 ABY]], a large number of Quarren and Mon Calamari were lured back to Dac under the pretext that the planet was being "renewed." Instead, these unfortunate Quarren and Mon Calamari were enslaved by a pirate syndicate led by the rogue Sith [[Darth Luft]], who forced them to build a fleet of ships in the remnants of the Mon Calamari Shipyards. Darth Luft and his pirates also kept their children and elderly relatives hostage. The Quarren and Mon Calamari ship builders were also beaten and mistreated by their pirate captors.<ref name="Legacy 8">[[Legacy (2013) 8|''Legacy'' (2013) 8]]</ref>

[[File:Dac_abyss.png|thumb|left|200px|Dac abyss following the Second Imperial Civil War]]

One Quarren named [[Tikin]] befriended a Mon Calamari environmental engineer named [[Luen]]. These two encountered the [[Imperial Knight]] [[Jao Assam]] and the junk dealer [[Ania Solo]], who learned about their predicament and quickly transmitted word of the pirates and their slaving operation to the Triumvirate authorities in Coruscant.<ref name="Legacy 8" /> Later, Tikin was murdered by Darth Luft and his death triggered a slave uprising by the Quarren and Mon Calamari, who joined forces to rebel against the pirates.<ref name="Legacy 9">[[Legacy (2013) 9|''Legacy'' (2013) 9]]</ref> This uprising coincided with an [[Liberation of Mon Calamari Shipyards|attack]] by the Galactic Triumvirate led by Admiral Stazi and the Imperial Knight [[Yalta Val]], who liberated the slaves and apprehended the pirates. Darth Luft himself was killed during a duel by Jao Assam. The Quarren and Mon Calamari then settled in the space station, which had been flooded with water by Admiral Stazi, to provide a comfortable atmosphere for the former slaves. As a gesture of reconciliation between the Quarren and Mon Calamari, Tikin's son [[Tilin]] was raised by Aunt Luen.<ref name="Legacy 10">[[Legacy (2013) 10|''Legacy'' (2013) 10]]</ref>

==Inhabitants==
===Residents===
Two sentient species, the Quarren and Mon Calamari, were [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to Dac. Of the planet's 27,500,000,000 pre-genocide inhabitants, 60% were Quarren, 39% Mon Calamari, and 1% members of other species. The planet had three major [[Language/Legends|languages]]: [[Mon Calamari (language)/Legends|Mon Calamarian]], [[Quarrenese/Legends|Quarrenese]], and [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]]. The Quarren were a pragmatic, [[Squid/Legends|squid]]-like species who tended to be isolationist in nature and work as [[Miner/Legends|miners]] and laborers. The Mon Calamari, meanwhile, were more [[Fish/Legends|fish]]-like and more inclined to be engineers and explorers. Their idealistic nature put them at odds with the Quarren.<ref name="Strongholds" />

===Government===
Dac had been ruled by a [[King of Mon Cala|monarchy]] for 83 generations. Their king would advise the Mon Calamari Council which was made up of [[Politics/Legends|politicians]] and other experts. Although a small number of Quarren chiefs served on the council, the majority was Mon Calamari.<ref name="Strongholds" />

But during Dac's enslavement by the Galactic Empire calls for changes to the government spread. Under Imperial rule the monarchy was fragmented, leading to a new government to take shape. The new government was based off the [[Chandrilan House|Chandrilian planetary government]] and renamed "Dac Council."<ref name="Strongholds" />

Under the Dac Council [[Governor/Legends|governors]] and [[deputy governor]]s were elected every two years from each colony and district on Dac. The governors and deputy governors on the council served as representatives for their respective districts and colonies. Candidates for leadership of the council are selected by each faction and put to a general vote. The winner of the election would be the [[Chief of State (Dac)|Chief of State]] while the runners-up would fill the positions of [[Prime Minister/Legends|prime minister]] and [[Defense minister (Dac)|defense minister]].<ref name="Strongholds" />

===Economy===
Dac's largest exports included [[Foodstuff/Legends|seafood]], high technology, and [[Starship/Legends|starships]], while its imports included medicine, technology, and foods. The [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards]] that orbited the planet produced numerous starships and were economically valuable.<ref name="Strongholds" />

===Culture===
[[Mon Calamari Ballet]] was practiced by the Mon Calamari, and was well-regarded throughout the galaxy. Popular [[Mon Calamari Shell Horn/Legends|shell horn]] bands and sculptors also hailed from the planet.<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Locations==
There were a number of [[City/Legends|cities]] located on Dac, including [[Aquarius]], [[Coral City/Legends|Mon Calamari City]] (also known as Coral City), [[Foamwander City]], and [[Quarren City]]. [[Drone shuttle]]s were used to carry people between the cities, which were heavily populated because they provided protection from the planet's many dangerous [[Diet/Legends|predators]]<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Calimari.png|thumb|left|200px|A city on Mon Calamari]]
This planet has been referred to by at least four different names throughout the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity:

The [[Bantha Tracks 17|17th issue]] of ''[[Bantha Tracks (department)|Bantha Tracks]]'', published in [[August]] [[1982]], provided a preview of the Mon Calamari and named their home planet Dac (before the Mon Calamari and Quarren made their first canonical appearance in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']]). Later EU sources, such as ''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'', ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]'' and [[Star Wars: The Jedi Academy Trilogy|''The Jedi Academy Trilogy'']], refer to the planet as "Calamari." However, in following years, most EU sources began to call the planet "Mon Calamari." To add to the confusion, the novel ''[[Assault at Selonia]]'' refers to it as "Mons Calamari." In the [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, the planet is referred to as "Mon Cala."<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

[[File:Mon_Calamari.jpg|thumb|220px|Mon Calamari]]
Despite its appearance in early sources, canonicity of the name "Dac" was initially disputed. The [[roleplaying game]] supplement ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'' brought Dac back into canon, noting that Dac was the name used by the natives in their own language for the world; some newer EU material has begun to refer to the planet by this name, where appropriate. Additionally, other recent EU literature has adopted the name Dac when referring to [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] members.

The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Mon Calamari in the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]]. The Sluis sector is actually located in the Outer Rim. Additionally, the in-game encyclopedia entry for the planet incorrectly states that Mon Calamari had only one [[Moon/Legends|moon]], and is one of the sources that states that the planet was first discovered by the Empire.
